title: Minimum site area of a proposed rear battleaxe lot (Table 3B)
text: Minimum and average site area. C4.1.1 Development which complies with the dwelling type and site area provisions set out in Table 3B and the following provisions. Table 3B Site area requirements. Minimum lot area/rear battleaxe (m2): R2 -; R2.5 -; R5 -; R10 925; R12.5 762.5; R15 655; R17.5 587.5; R20 450; R25 425; R30 410; R35 395; R40 380; R50 160; R60 120; R80 100; R100-SL -. R80 site area provisions apply to all grouped dwellings located on lots coded R100, R160 and LR, MR and HR. - Indicated not applicable.

replaces.note: rear battleaxe column; current footnote limited it to single houses, now removed

verified.note: Battleaxe values checked. C4.1.5 to C4.1.7 reduce 'the minimum and average site area of Table 3B'; whether that reaches the 'Minimum lot area/rear battleaxe' column is not stated on the page (p53-54).

notes: diverges: Table 3B (p54) for Table 2B; test otherwise as the Chapter 2 twin. Applies where the subdivision creates a battleaxe lot. Battleaxe column now reads as applying to grouped dwelling lots (footnote removed; ch3-089, verify). Concessions not applied to the battleaxe column.
